name: Nix binary caches
auth: Use an access or reference token as the HTTP Basic password, with AW_USER equal to its subject. The subject needs read permission for installation and deploy permission for publication on the selected repository; token scopes cannot exceed that identity. The same clients also accept a user password when Basic password authentication is enabled. Use HTTPS.
fresh_home: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.
prerequisites: A disposable Nix environment; the acceptance container runs as root.
The exact /nix/store path to copy and an independently verified public signing key.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
AW_AUTH_URL=$(python3 - <<'PYCODE'
import os
from urllib.parse import quote, urlsplit, urlunsplit
u = urlsplit(os.environ["AW_URL"])
auth = quote(os.environ["AW_USER"], safe="") + ":" + quote(os.environ["AW_TOKEN"], safe="")
print(urlunsplit((u.scheme, auth + "@" + u.netloc, u.path, "", "")))
PYCODE
)
AW_NIX_URL="$AW_AUTH_URL/artifactory/api/nix/$AW_REPO"
configure.note: Run in a disposable pinned Nix container; Python 3 is only needed for URL encoding. Keep credential-bearing variables out of logs. Set AW_NIX_PUBLIC_KEY to the operator-verified cache signing key.

publish.note: Publish to a local or one-node federated repository. Remote repositories are read-through caches; select the local deployment member when reading through a virtual.

steps.code:
AW_STORE_PATH=$(nix-store --add ./payload)
env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command copy --to "$AW_NIX_URL?compression=xz" "$AW_STORE_PATH"
steps.note: payload is a directory of files. The server must have its Nix signing key configured.

install.note: Select a local, remote, virtual or one-node federated repository with read permission. Dependencies must also be available through that repository.

steps.code: env HOME="$AW_WORK/home" nix --extra-experimental-features nix-command --option require-sigs true --option trusted-public-keys "$AW_NIX_PUBLIC_KEY" copy --from "$AW_NIX_URL" --to "local?root=$AW_WORK/consumer" "$AW_STORE_PATH"
steps.note: Supply the exact store path from the producer. A new local store root ensures substitution reaches the cache.

limitations: Store signatures stay required; do not solve failures with require-sigs=false.

contains: Scenario Outline: native Nix publishes and verifies hosted binary cache signatures
